vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module implements graph normalization, acting as a critical post-processing layer for raw graph data. Its primary functions include merging duplicate nodes, resolving internal documentation links specified in markdown, and cleaning up the graph structure by removing self-references and redundant edges. It consumes GraphData and outputs a NormalizeReport detailing cleanup metrics, ensuring subsequent analysis operates on a canonical dataset.
